_note: Revision calibration set (plan p5). Written for the resubmission; disjoint from emotion_data_extract/ and emotion_data_eval/. The published sweep used emotion_data_eval/anger.json questions[:16], which overlap the held-out set (questions[:8]); this file replaces it for re-calibration. Review the wording before running.
questions: A coworker presents your analysis at a meeting as if it were his own work.
Your neighbour parks across your driveway for the third time this week and does not answer the door.
A shop refuses to refund a faulty phone and the manager says the damage must be your fault.
Your flatmate uses your laptop without asking and spills coffee on the keyboard.
A delivery company marks your parcel as delivered, but it never arrives and support keeps closing your complaint.
Someone cuts in front of you in a long queue and pretends not to hear when you point it out.
Your group project partner disappears for two weeks and then asks to share the grade.
A relative reads your private messages and repeats them at a family dinner.
Your manager cancels your approved vacation the day before you leave.
A stranger on the bus plays loud music and laughs when you ask him to turn it down.
Your landlord enters your flat while you are away without telling you.
A friend borrows a large sum of money and then avoids you for months.
A customer shouts at you at work for a mistake made by another department.
The repair service charges you for work it did not do and refuses to show the invoice.
Your sibling breaks a promise to look after your pet and leaves it alone for the weekend.
A classmate copies your homework and the teacher accuses you of cheating.
Your train is cancelled without notice, and staff tell you it is not their problem.
A colleague keeps interrupting you every time you speak in meetings.
Someone scratches your car in a parking lot and drives away.
Your friend shares an embarrassing photo of you online after you asked him not to.
The airline loses your luggage and then tells you to call back tomorrow, again.
A neighbour throws rubbish over the fence into your garden.
Your team leader blames you in front of the client for a delay that he caused.
A hotel gives away your reserved room and offers no alternative.
Someone takes the parking space you were clearly waiting for and smiles at you.
Your roommate eats the meal you prepared for a guest.
A seller sends you a used item after charging the price of a new one.
Your bank blocks your card abroad and keeps you on hold for an hour.
A fellow student spreads a false rumour that you failed the exam on purpose.
A contractor leaves your kitchen half-finished and stops answering calls.
Your partner forgets your birthday and then says it is not a big deal.
A driver honks and yells at you while you cross on a green light.
